scenes.name: ONE TURN
lines: Start at the north pole, and turn about a single axis.
从北极 N 出发，只绕一根轴转。
The point sweeps one circle and comes back home. One kind of turn draws only a circle.
点沿一条子午圆走一整圈，又回到 N：只转一种，只画得出一个圆。

scenes.name: TWO ANGLES
lines: First step: tilt about the y axis by theta. The height drops to cosine theta.
正交一次：绕 e₂ 倾转 θ，高度降到 cos θ。
Second step: twist about the vertical axis by phi. The height stays, and the point swings round its latitude.
正交两次：绕竖轴 e₃ 拧转 φ，高度不变，点沿着纬度圈转过去。
Sixty degrees, then forty-five: we land at root six over four, root six over four, one half.
Two angles reach every point. Only at the poles does the twist do nothing.
两个角走遍整颗球；只在两极，第二步白拧。

scenes.name: SKEW AXES
lines: The two axes need not be perpendicular. Thirty degrees apart, four turns still reach the target.
两根轴不必正交：只差 30°，交替转四次，照样到达目标。
Lean checks that any rotation is a finite word in two axes that are not parallel.
只要两轴不共线，任一旋转都是绕它们的有限旋转字，由 Lean 内核检验。

scenes.name: ORDER
lines: Now swap the order. Quarter turn about Y, then about X: we end on plus X.
现在调换次序。先绕 Y、再绕 X 各转 90°：停在 +X。
About X first, then Y: we end on minus Y, ninety degrees away.
先绕 X、再绕 Y：停在 −Y，两个终点相隔 90°。
In each second step the point stays put, yet the arrow it carries turns a quarter.
两条路的第二步里点都不动，它带着的小箭头却各转了四分之一圈。

scenes.name: OCTANT LOOP
lines: Walk a closed loop: north, to plus X, to plus Y, and home.
走一圈闭合回路：N → +X → +Y → N。
Carry the arrow without twisting it. It comes back turned by ninety degrees.
一路不拧箭头，平行搬运；回到 N 时，它转过了 90°。
That is the enclosed area, pi over two, one eighth of the sphere.
这正是圈住的面积 Ω = π/2，整颗球的八分之一。
The literature gives the spin a Berry phase of minus half that area: minus pi over four.
文献给出，自旋攒下的贝里相位是这块面积的负一半：γ = −π/4。

scenes.name: PAIRWISE PHASE
lines: The same angle is already written in the pairwise overlaps.
同一个角，早就写在两两内积里。
On the equator, Lean checks the overlap formula: plus X against plus Y gives one plus i, over two.
赤道上，同纬度内积公式由 Lean 内核检验：+X 与 +Y 的内积是 (1 + i)/2。
Multiply the three overlaps around the loop: one plus i, over four. Its phase is pi over four.
沿回路把三个内积连乘：Δ = (1 + i)/4，相位 π/4。
Re-phase each state however you like: the product does not move.
给每个态任意乘上局部相位：连乘积纹丝不动。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Geometric Intuition of Quantum Computing, part three.
《量子计算的几何直觉》· 第三部
